buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Vendor should not quote less than 3.85% service charge. If any vendor quoting below 3.85% servic e charge will not be considered, and bid will be disqualified. 2. Firms submitting the bids shall be registered with any of the DRDO Labs/Govt. Organizations/ PSUs. 3. Vendor cannot claim any monitory benefits in any form from the candidate being deployed at DRDL. Any such incident/ complaint noticed / received from user / candidate the contract shall be immediate ly terminated and the vendor will be deregistered and debarred from DRDL/ DRDO. Vendor shall sub

mit this declaration along with the Technical Bid. 4. Vendor shall submit the declaration along with the technical bid that they have understood the scope of work and shall comply with DRDL terms and conditions. 5. The selection criteria, qualification, competence of the candidates shall be in DRDL scope. The candi dates selected by DRDL, including replacement if require shall only be considered for carrying out the work. 6. Vendor has to submit price breakup as per the Price bid format enclosed at RFP part –VII and vendor should not Quote less than the Minimum Wage mentioned in price bid format (Part -VII) if firm quoting less, the bid Will not be considered, and bid will be disqualified. 7. Payment term and other elements of wages will be governed as per general terms and conditions me ntioned in RFP Part-V. 8. Vendor shall follow RFP terms, general terms and conditions and instructions given in RFP regarding s ubmission of Technical and price bids. 9. Vendor should not attach the price bid with technical documents. Submission of the same along with t echnical bid will lead to disqualification of bid. 10. Vendor should upload correct documents. Submission of fake documents if any will lead to severe a ction against the firm including rejection of bids. 11. ESI Registration or Sub code from Local office is compulsory if order is placed. 12. Performance Security Bond 5% of Order value or Monthly Payment (Which ever is lower) inclusive of Taxes. 13. This profit % quoted amount will be fixed throughout the contract period irrespective of wage increas e by Govt. 14. The amount includes insurance premium charges towards comprehensive accidental insurance. 15. Bidders should have office/Branch office in the state of consignee i.e. Telangana In case bidders do no t have office at the time of bidding successful bidders shall have to establish the office within 30 days of award of contract. .
